artworks.title: The Blue Winged Shoveler (Anas clypeata foemina)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird. The bird is shown in profile, standing on a small patch of grass. Its plumage is predominantly brown with detailed feather textures. The wings have sections of blue and green. The bird has a broad beak with distinct patterning, vivid eyes, and pinkish-orange legs and webbed feet. The background is plain, emphasizing the bird. The drawing is detailed, possibly for scientific or illustrative purposes, reminiscent of historical ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: The Mangrove Snapper (Labrus griseus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a fish with spiny dorsal fins and a prominent tail fin. The fish is colored in shades of brown with a gradient that fades to lighter hues along its belly, complemented by darker detailing on its scales. Its eye is accentuated with a reddish-brown outline. The fish is positioned horizontally in the center of the image against a plain, light background.

artworks.title: The Porgy (Sparus chrysops)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image displays a fish with a dark brown back and a shaded, bluish-silver body. It has large yellow-ringed eyes, a prominent mouth, and a dorsal fin with sharp spines. The colors used are dark brown, bluish-silver, yellow, and hints of green. The fish is positioned horizontally with its head to the left, tail to the right, and lower fin downward near the center.

artworks.title: The Muray (Muraena helena)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a moray eel. The image shows a detailed and accurate representation of a moray eel, with its elongated, serpentine form curving across the canvas. The eel has dark skin with small, darker spots along its body. Its mouth is open, showing sharp teeth, and its eye is prominently depicted. The background is a plain, neutral tone.

artworks.title: The Black Muray (Muraenae helenae varietas)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large dark blue eel among tall, slender, branching coral structures. The eel is dark blue and black, while the coral is golden brown against a light background. The eel's head is on the left, with its body winding through the coral branches that rise vertically in the image.

artworks.title: The Cat Fish (Silurus catus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: An illustration of a catfish is depicted with its elongated, rounded body and barbels extending from its face. The color palette consists of dark blues, grays, and hints of brown on the fins and barbels. The fish is positioned horizontally across the page, its head facing to the right and tail to the left, with its dorsal and ventral fins visible.

artworks.title: The Ribbon Snake (Coluber saurita)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with green leaves and red and green berries, accompanied by a coiled snake at the bottom right. The color palette includes green, red, brown, and subtle yellow tones. The branch spreads out in all directions, with the snake positioned under the lower branches.

artworks.title: The Ribbon Snake (Coluber saurita)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large plant with clusters of green leaves and purple berries. A coiled brown snake with a striped pattern is located at the base of the plant. The colors in the image include shades of green for the leaves, rich purple for the berries, earthy brown for the snake, and a subtle beige background. Small pops of red can be seen from flowers among the leaves and berries. The snake is nestled in the lower right section of the image, while the plant extends upwards and slightly to the right and left, with the berries clustering towards the upper sections of the branches.

artworks.title: The Ribbon Snake (Coluber saurita)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image features a botanical illustration of a leafy plant with smooth, elongated leaves, clusters of small, round berries, and a coiled snake. The color palette consists of various shades of green for the leaves with hints of blue, while the berries are deep red and green. The snake has brown, olive, and yellow stripes. The plant's branches spread outward, some with clusters of berries at the tips. The snake is coiled at the base with its head slightly facing upwards.

artworks.title: The Barracuda (Esox barracuda)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two large fish side by side in a horizontal orientation. The upper fish is dark blue with lighter iridescent scales, while the lower fish is brown with a slightly golden tint. The background is a light beige color. Both fish are shown facing to the right, with sharp teeth visible and detailed fin patterns.

artworks.title: The Croker (Perca undulata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two large fish. The top fish is brown with yellow eyes, while the lower fish is reddish with yellow eyes. The color palette includes brown, red, purple, green, and yellow. The top fish is positioned above the lower fish, both facing right. Both fish are detailed and set against a plain background.

artworks.title: The Pilchard (Argentina carolina)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a green-leafed plant with pods hanging among its branches and a fish lying beneath it. The color palette includes greens for the plant and blues and grays for the fish. The upper two-thirds of the image prominently features the leaves and pods, while the fish is positioned horizontally along the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: The Sucking Fish (Echeneis naucratis)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a leafy branch with green leaves and red flowers, with a fish labeled "Remora" at the bottom. The color palette includes shades of green, brown, and reddish-orange on a light beige background. The fish is horizontal in the foreground, while the vertical branch is central and slightly tilted to the right.

artworks.title: The Sole (Pleuronectes lunatus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large fish with an oval-shaped body decorated with blue circular patterns across its brown, textured skin. The color palette consists mainly of dark brown and blue against a light beige background. The fish is oriented horizontally with its head to the right, a large eye visible, and fins flaring out along the top and bottom edges of its body. The tail fin is slightly splayed out at the left end of the fish.

artworks.title: Centipede (Scolopendra morsitans)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with large green leaves, intricate yellow flowers, and brown stems, set against a pale background. The color palette consists of rich greens, muted yellows, and earthy browns. At the bottom, there is a segmented, brown millipede across the width, while clusters of yellow flowers are seen on the stems and leaves. The central arrangement of the leaves and flowers creates balance, with the millipede providing contrast at the base.

artworks.title: The Ground Dove (Columba passerina)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with green leaves and small, round fruits at the top. A bird known as "The Ground Dove" with brown feathers is pictured on the left side of the image. The color scheme includes green, brown, and beige tones.

artworks.title: The Towhe Bird (Fringilla erythrophthalma)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on green leaves. The upper bird has a black body with accents of orange and red on its side, identified as "The Towhe Bird" in the text below, while the lower bird appears in darker brown and sandy tones, labeled as "The cow-pen Bird." Both birds are depicted with realistic detail, showing the intricate feather patterns and nuanced coloring. The background is a plain off-white, which helps the vibrant green of the leaves and the birds' contrasting colors to stand out. The leaves are illustrated with fine veining and a naturalistic structure. The style suggests a traditional natural history illustration, where the subject is rendered with scientific precision and an emphasis on clarity.

artworks.title: The Little Brown Flycatcher
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two birds perched on a tree branch. The top bird is labeled as the "little brown Flycatcher" and the lower bird as the "red Eyed Flycatcher." The color palette includes brown tones for the birds, green for the leaves, and subtle hints of red in the flowers near the leaves. The upper bird is positioned to the right near the top, while the lower bird is slightly larger and placed towards the lower right, next to the green leaves and flowers on the left.

artworks.title: The Finch Creeper (Parus americanus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The largest objects in the image are green leaves, a blue and yellow bird, and white bell-shaped flowers. The color palette includes shades of green, blue, yellow, brown, white, and hints of pink and orange. The plant occupies the center and left portion of the image with large, elongated leaves, while the bird is positioned to the right, perched on a branch. White flowers are distributed along the branches beside the bird.

artworks.title: The Bald Eagle (Falco leucocephalus)
artworks.artist: Johann Michael Seligmann after Mark Catesby
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bald eagle in pursuit of fish. The image portrays a bald eagle as it swoops down towards a fish it is catching. Its wings are outstretched and powerful, with detailed illustration of the feathers. The talons are extended to grasp the fish. Above, there is a second bird sketched in flight. Below, a detailed depiction of a fish shows bright colors and scales. The text around the image is in multiple languages, including German, Latin, and French, with similar phrases in each language. This drawing showcases wildlife illustration, likely created for educational purposes.

artworks.title: The Muray (Muraena helena)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of an eel. It shows a detailed representation of an eel-like fish with a long, slender body, textured scales, an open mouth with sharp teeth, and an eye looking forward. The color palette is predominantly dark green with subtle yellow undertones. The eel's body curves elegantly against a neutral background, in a style reminiscent of natural history artwork, often used in scientific studies, similar to 18th-century naturalist illustrations.

artworks.title: The Grey Fox Squirrel (Sciurus cinereus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a squirrel with a large bushy tail next to a yellow flowering plant. The squirrel has a greyish-brown fur and a fluffy tail that arches over its back. It is facing a tall plant with yellow flowers and green leaves. The illustration is detailed, showcasing the fur texture of the squirrel and the pattern on the flower petals. Additionally, two brown bulbs with sprouts are shown on the right side of the squirrel. The drawing follows a style reminiscent of natural history illustrations, emphasizing realism and accuracy.

artworks.title: The Red Legged Thrush (Turdus plumbeus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large gray bird perched on a branch surrounded by leaves and small hanging fruits. The color palette includes earthy tones, with shades of gray for the bird, various greens for the leaves, and deep purple for the fruits. The bird is positioned centrally on the branch, with leaves and fruits surrounding it.

artworks.title: The Little Brown Duck (Anas rustica)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a duck next to a leafy branch with berries. The drawing depicts a duck and a branch with green leaves and berries.
